tools.description: Create and manage project tasks, set dependencies, assign crew, and track pre-production milestones.

actions.description: Create a new task in the EEVL Production space for each project milestone.

parameters.name: string — task name (e.g., 'Pre-Production Complete')
parameters.dependencies: array — task IDs this task depends on

actions.description: Update task status, assignees, or due dates as pre-production progresses.

parameters.custom_fields: object — key-value pairs for pillar, shoot-date, etc.

tools.description: Create the project Lark channel, add members, and post the project summary as a pinned message.

actions.description: Create a dedicated project channel named #proj-{client-slug}-{date}.

parameters.name: string — channel name following EEVL naming convention
parameters.description: string — channel purpose and project summary
parameters.members: array — Lark user IDs for crew and project manager

actions.description: Post the project summary and pin it in the channel.

parameters.pin: boolean — true to pin the message

tools.description: Store the client brief, create the project folder structure, and upload the shot list and checklists.

actions.description: Create the project folder hierarchy under EEVL Productions.
Upload the client brief and generated documents to the project folder.

tools.description: Create or update the client workspace page in Notion with project details, contacts, and timeline.

actions.description: Create a new client workspace page under the EEVL Clients database.

properties.ClickUp Task Link: string — URL to main ClickUp task

actions.description: Update the client workspace page as the project progresses.

tools.description: Tier 2 escalation — persistent Cowork workspace for complex location research, competitor analysis, and multi-location logistics planning.

actions.description: Send a research or synthesis task to the content-production Cowork workspace.

parameters.task_description: string — what to research or synthesize
parameters.attachments: array — Google Drive file IDs or URLs to include

returns.task_id: string — Cowork task ID for status tracking

tools.escalation_criteria: Only use when Tier 1 tools cannot complete the task — e.g., multi-location research, competitor analysis, complex logistics planning.

tools.description: Tier 3 escalation — Computer Use for vendor portal permit applications that have no API. Requires user approval.

actions.description: Start a Computer Use session targeting a specific vendor portal for permit filing.

parameters.task_description: string — what to do (e.g., 'Fill out city film permit application')
parameters.attachments: array — files to upload during the session (insurance docs, project details)

returns.screenshots: array — key screenshots from the session

tools.escalation_criteria: Only use when the vendor portal has NO API and no other path exists. Always try Tier 1 first (email, phone, API). This is the last resort.

tools.description: Write project timeline from ClickUp milestones to OmniPlan for Gantt chart export.

actions.description: Create an OmniPlan project from ClickUp task schedule via AppleScript.
Export the OmniPlan Gantt chart as PDF for client presentation.
